load_pretrained_musicgen_model: load a pretrained MusicGen model by name such as facebook/musicgen-small or facebook/musicgen-melody
set_musicgen_generation_params: set MusicGen generation parameters including sampling strategy, temperature, top_k, top_p, duration, and CFG coefficient
generate_music_with_chroma: generate music audio conditioned on text descriptions and melody waveforms using the MusicGen melody model
set_musicgen_style_conditioner_params: set style conditioner parameters for MusicGen-Style model including quantization streams and excerpt length
prepare_musicgen_tokens_and_attributes: prepare conditioning attributes and prompt tokens from text descriptions, audio prompts, and melody waveforms
